note: Per-platform engine artifacts. The installer ships WITHOUT the ~840MB engine (downloader model) and provisions the entry matching the running build. LOBSTER_ENGINE_URL/LOBSTER_ENGINE_SHA256 override this for testing/self-hosting. A platform with no entry fails provisioning with a clear error rather than downloading another OS's archive.

rebuildPending.why: The repo repinned from 152.0.7928.0 (a CANARY nightly, near-unique in fullVersionList) to the M152 beta-frozen release build. The linux-x64 entry still names the OLD artifact on purpose: version/url/sha256 may only move once a rebuilt tarball actually exists, or first-run provisioning breaks for every user. Until then the installer provisions the previous engine and ENGINE_CHROME claims one patch newer within the same milestone.
rebuildPending.howToClear: On the Linux build host: lobium/rebase.sh 152.0.7977.42 --run && lobium/build.sh --run && scripts/package-lobium-runtime.sh, then `node scripts/bump-engine-version.mjs 152.0.7977.42 --tarball <lobium-linux-x64.tar.gz>` to rewrite version/url/sha256 and drop this block.

win-x64Pending.why: The prior Windows 152.0.7977.42 official/PGO/ThinLTO binary predates the current patch series and capability-contract v2, so the launcher correctly refuses it. No win-x64 entry is listed because publishing that stale binary would silently omit current native protections, while naming an artifact that does not exist would make first-run provisioning fail after a large download.
win-x64Pending.howToClear: On the Windows build host: force-clean the exact 152.0.7977.42 checkout, rerun lobium/build.ps1 with official/PGO/ThinLTO settings, pass the capability and real-browser gates, package with scripts/package-lobium-runtime.ps1, compress dist-win/lobium-runtime to lobium-win-x64.zip, upload it, then run `node scripts/bump-engine-version.mjs 152.0.7977.42 --platform win-x64 --archive <lobium-win-x64.zip> --url <published-url>`.
